name: Baidu Ping Booster Pro
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Baidu Ping Booster Pro is an essential enterprise-grade tool for any WordPress site targeting the Chinese search engine market. Developed by Sami Jewellers & Software Solutions, this plugin ensures your fresh content is discovered, crawled, and indexed by Baidu as quickly as possible.

Visit our official website for updates and support: Ping Booster Site

Key Features (v2.0.0):

  • Automated Pinging: Automatically sends an XML-RPC ping to Baidu’s indexing service whenever you publish or update a post, page, or custom post type.
  • Instant Indexing: Dramatically reduces the time it takes for new content to appear in Baidu search results.
  • Baidu XML Sitemap: Generates a dedicated, Baidu-compliant XML sitemap for posts, pages, products, categories, and tags.
  • Manual Ping Tool: An admin dashboard tool to manually push URLs or your entire site’s homepage to Baidu.
  • Baidu Tongji Integration: Easily inject your Baidu Tongji analytics tracking ID into your site headers without editing theme files.
  • Advanced Pro Controls: Enhanced logging and connection settings optimized for performance.

How to Use the Plugin

Getting started with Baidu Ping Booster Pro is quick and easy. Follow these steps to configure and run the plugin:

  1. Activate the Plugin:
    After uploading and activating the plugin via your WordPress dashboard (Plugins > Installed Plugins), look for the new Baidu Booster menu item in your left sidebar.

  2. Configure General Settings:

    • Click on Baidu Booster to open the main dashboard.
    • Enter your website’s primary domain URL and verify your connection parameters.
    • Enable Automated Pinging so that every time you hit “Publish” or “Update” on a post, the plugin instantly alerts Baidu.

  3. Manage the Baidu XML Sitemap:

    • Navigate to the Sitemap tab within the plugin settings.
    • Select which post types (Posts, Pages, Products) you want included in your custom Baidu sitemap feed.
    • Submit your generated sitemap URL directly to the Baidu Webmaster Platform.

  4. Use the Manual Ping Tool:

    • If you have updated old content or want to force-index a specific new URL immediately, navigate to the Manual Ping section.
    • Paste the exact URL into the input box and click Send Ping to instantly notify the Baidu crawler.

  5. Set Up Baidu Analytics (Tongji):

    • Go to the Analytics tab in the plugin settings.
    • Paste your Baidu Tongji Tracking ID string into the designated field and save changes. The plugin will automatically append the tracking script to your site.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin package (ZIP format).
  2. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose your ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin upon successful installation.
  6. Configure your options via the Baidu Booster menu.
sections.faq:
Who developed this plugin?

This plugin is developed, maintained, and supported by Samee Ullah Feroz. For more details, documentation, and tools, visit our official portal at https://pingbooster.site.

Does this plugin guarantee indexing?

While search engine indexing behavior depends on Baidu’s algorithms and content quality, this plugin drastically speeds up the discovery and notification process, ensuring Baidu is alerted the second your content goes live.

Can I use this alongside other SEO plugins?

Yes! Baidu Ping Booster Pro works seamlessly alongside popular plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO. It handles the specific infrastructure for Baidu pinging and Tongji tracking.

2.0.0

  • Major release with enhanced UI and optimized XML-RPC communication pipeline.
  • Added native Baidu Tongji tracking ID integration.
  • Improved error logging for failed or delayed server pings.
  • Updated asset packaging including official banners, icons, and detailed dashboard screenshots.

1.0.0

  • Initial stable release with basic automated pinging and XML sitemap support.
